summary.intent: Verify and resolve or dismiss open review findings on changes 81 and 82 (PRs #473 and #474), then keep going on the work, including closing documentation drift and adding a docs checklist line to the PR template.
summary.outcome: All five findings were verified against the code, fixed with tests and mutation checks, pushed, and resolved. PR #476 was opened to update ARCHITECTURE.md and release.md, and a docs line was committed to the PR template on that branch (not yet pushed). No PRs had merged; all four are awaiting review.

repo: AGENTS.md:23 forbids adding a git process per package; changes that do so fail review. Source-change listing must skip covered packages and use batched tree-id checks.
changed.rs has an existing RecordingGit runner usable for counting git processes in tests.
TagName in callisto-model implements Display, so to_string() is the way to get a string ref for URLs.
Fence-aware scanning should use the shared Fences tracker (group_openers) rather than a second ad hoc scanner.
Commits are signed and the verify.sh script runs pre-push, lint, doc-check, test and workflow contract scripts; it must exit 0 before commit.
The repo has .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md for the PR checklist.
Spec criteria (e.g. REL-PR-04, REL-PR-10, VER-CS-09/10, VER-APPLY-07A, CLI-PATH-01) and docs/architecture/versioning.md are updated per PR, but ARCHITECTURE.md and release.md had drifted.

code.finding: Rule that adding a git process per package fails review; the uncovered_changes source listing violated it.
Empty-plan path returned early, dropping the not-releasing list and wrongly claiming the workspace was up to date.
Compare URL built from raw tag refs; a # or ? in a tag template broke the path. Fixed with encode_ref percent-encoding. A stray duplicate doc line sat above changelog_repository.
Group release-notes merge treated headings inside fenced code as boundaries; now uses the shared Fences tracker and ignores bullets in fences.

workflow: Mutation-checking each fix (revert it, confirm the new test fails, restore) confirmed the tests were meaningful.
All-or-nothing patch scripts that refuse on ambiguous anchors prevent partial writes; use unique full-line anchors.
Edit tool is preferable to nested shell/Python quoting when patching scripts.
Resolve findings with messages naming the fix commit and the covering tests.
An architecture-conformance audit was never run, which let doc drift go unnoticed; checking docs against changed flows should be routine.

friction: Patch script refused on an ambiguous anchor, so nothing was written and it had to be redone.
Deeply nested shell/Python quoting while patching the script failed and was abandoned for the Edit tool.
Passing a TagName where a string was expected caused a compile error.
A stray duplicate doc line left by an earlier refactor had to be cleaned up.
No PRs had merged, so dependent follow-up work was blocked on review.
open_items: PRs #473, #474, #475 and #476 each need a review and merge.
The PR template docs-line commit on docs/architecture-release-preview was committed but not yet pushed.
The three open PRs need to add their own ARCHITECTURE.md/release.md lines after they merge.
NEXT-WORK.md in the repo and the artifact page are stale and were not updated.
No architecture-conformance check (such as the scribe architecture audit) has been run against the model.
